title: Interior
shortDesc: Rooms, trim, and ceilings with prep before color.
fullDesc: {{name}} paints interiors in {{city}} and {{region}}. You get a walk-through and a written estimate before work starts.
heading: Prep, then color
body: Paint over bad patches shows every shortcut. We scope repairs during the estimate.

faq.a: We talk through what needs to move before the start date so the rooms stay usable.

title: Exterior
shortDesc: Siding, trim, and the outside of the building.
fullDesc: {{name}} paints exteriors in {{region}} after scrape, caulk, and prime where the job needs it.
heading: Edges fail first
body: Peeling starts at trim and open caulk. We look there before quoting a full coat.

faq.a: We schedule around temperature and rain. Call {{phone}} for the next opening.

title: Cabinets
shortDesc: Kitchen and bath cabinets finished so they look planned.
fullDesc: {{name}} finishes cabinets in {{city}} with the prep and sheen the doors actually need.
heading: Doors fail when they are rushed
body: If the boxes are failing, a finish will not make them new. We say that on the walk-through.

faq.a: We pick the method for the room and the sheen, and we tell you which one before we start.

title: Commercial
shortDesc: Offices and suites scheduled around how you use the building.
fullDesc: {{name}} paints commercial spaces in {{region}} with a schedule that respects open hours.
heading: The building still has to work
body: We scope access, odor, and which rooms can close before anyone opens a can.

faq.q: Can you work while we are open?
faq.a: Often in phases. Tell us the hours on the form or call {{phone}}.
